shared_or_similar_visual_information: A dashed curved portion of a circular rim in a drawing of a solid.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The occluded rear portion of a circular base rim in a solid drawing. Right image: The occluded rear portion of a circular base rim in a solid drawing.
Rationales: Each broken arc completes the far side of a rim whose near side is solid. The dashes specify which part of the circular rim is hidden in the depicted view.
